title: pi*0.6: a VLA That Learns From Experience
method_tags: RECAP; advantage-conditioned policy; offline RL; corrections; autonomous experience
relevance_to_direction: Anchor paper. Shows large-scale VLA self-improvement, but relies on PI internal pi0.6/pi*0.6 and large data. Our direction should target the open-source post-hoc version.

title: RL Token: Bootstrapping Online RL with VLAs
method_tags: RL token; frozen VLA; small actor-critic; online RL; precision manipulation
relevance_to_direction: Closest inspiration. It trains a native RL token inside pi0.6. Our gap is plug-in tokenization for existing open-source VLAs without pretraining-time access.

title: pi0.6 Model Card
method_tags: Gemma3 backbone; action expert; FAST tokens; metadata conditioning
relevance_to_direction: Important for understanding why PI can add native conditioning and RL token interfaces. Not directly reproducible for ordinary labs.

title: pi0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
method_tags: flow matching; action chunks; general robot control
relevance_to_direction: Background for PI action representation and flow-matching VLA design.

title: pi0.5: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
method_tags: open-world generalization; heterogeneous data; high-level subtasks
relevance_to_direction: OpenPI pi0.5 is the most relevant PI-style open-source base to test plug-in RLT ideas.

title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
method_tags: OpenVLA; 7B VLA; fine-tuning; robot manipulation
relevance_to_direction: Strong open-source baseline. Useful for testing whether post-hoc tokenization generalizes beyond PI-style models.

title: SmolVLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model trained on LeRobot Community Data
method_tags: compact VLA; LeRobot; flow matching; async inference
relevance_to_direction: Most feasible base for one GPU and single-arm experiments. Good first implementation target.

title: Vision Language Action Models in Robotic Manipulation: A Systematic Review
method_tags: VLA taxonomy; datasets; simulators; manipulation
relevance_to_direction: Survey reference for positioning the topic and related work taxonomy.

title: VLA-RL: Towards Masterful and General Robotic Manipulation with Scalable Reinforcement Learning
method_tags: online RL; process reward model; OpenVLA; LIBERO
relevance_to_direction: Shows VLA+RL works, but mostly large-scale/sim benchmark oriented. Supports the need for real-robot and resource-limited alternatives.

title: SimpleVLA-RL: Scaling VLA Training via Reinforcement Learning
method_tags: veRL; trajectory sampling; OpenVLA-OFT; scalable RL
relevance_to_direction: Useful baseline for scalable VLA RL, but less suited to small real-robot labs due to infrastructure assumptions.

title: CO-RFT: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language-Action Models through Chunked Offline Reinforcement Learning
method_tags: chunked RL; TD over action chunks; 30-60 demos
relevance_to_direction: Important because it attacks low-data VLA fine-tuning and action chunking. Competes with the offline part of our method.

title: A Vision-Language-Action-Critic Model for Robotic Real-World Reinforcement Learning
method_tags: process reward; progress delta; done signal; human-in-loop RL
relevance_to_direction: Closest critic/reward work. Our method should not claim generic reward-model novelty; instead use critic as auxiliary signal for plug-in RL tokens.

title: SOLE-R1: Video-Language Reasoning as the Sole Reward for On-Robot Reinforcement Learning
method_tags: video-language reward; dense progress; RL reward hacking
relevance_to_direction: Very hot reward direction. It raises the bar for VLM rewards and highlights reward hacking risk; not ideal as our sole contribution.

title: RL-100: Performant Robotic Manipulation with Real-World Reinforcement Learning
method_tags: diffusion policy; offline+online RL; consistency distillation
relevance_to_direction: Shows real-world RL can eliminate residual failure modes. Strong motivation for precision-stage online RL.

title: GR-RL: Going Dexterous and Precise for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
method_tags: progress filtering; symmetry augmentation; online RL; latent noise predictor
relevance_to_direction: Important competitor for turning VLA generalists into precise specialists. Suggests progress filtering and latent-space RL are strong baselines.

title: Refined Policy Distillation: From VLA Generalists to RL Experts
method_tags: teacher-guided RL; student expert policy; sample-efficient exploration
relevance_to_direction: Alternative to plug-in RLT: distill a VLA into a smaller RL expert. Our argument should emphasize keeping the VLA policy and adding post-hoc correction.

title: Jump-Start Reinforcement Learning with Vision-Language-Action Regularization
method_tags: PPO regularization; sparse VLA guidance; annealed imitation
relevance_to_direction: Related to using VLA as a guide rather than final policy. Good baseline for whether plug-in tokens beat simple VLA action regularization.

title: VLA-RFT: Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Fine-tuning with Verified Rewards in World Simulators
method_tags: world simulator; verified reward; trajectory-level reward
relevance_to_direction: Competing low-risk alternative to real-world online RL. Useful as related work, but not aligned with single real-arm contribution.

title: World-Env: Leveraging World Model as a Virtual Environment for VLA Post-Training
method_tags: video world simulator; VLM reflector; termination prediction
relevance_to_direction: Shows another route to reduce real interactions. Our work should argue for cheap real-stage correction rather than full virtual simulator.

title: ThinkAct: Vision-Language-Action Reasoning via Reinforced Visual Latent Planning
method_tags: visual latent planning; reinforced reasoning; long horizon
relevance_to_direction: Related to high-level reasoning. Lower priority for single-arm precision unless combined with phase selection.

title: VLA-R1: Enhancing Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models
method_tags: RLVR; GRPO; chain-of-thought; verifiable rewards
relevance_to_direction: Hot R1-style framing. Useful for paper positioning, but the implementation/data requirements may be high.

title: FocusVLA: Focused Visual Utilization for Vision-Language-Action Models
method_tags: task-relevant patches; attention; visual token selection
relevance_to_direction: Relevant to token adaptor design: a plug-in RL token may benefit from selecting task-relevant visual features.

title: StreamingVLA: Streaming Vision-Language-Action Model with Action Flow Matching and Adaptive Early Observation
method_tags: streaming execution; action flow matching; adaptive observation
relevance_to_direction: Useful deployment context. Phase-gated residual control should account for latency and action chunk alignment.

title: ManipArena: Comprehensive Real-world Evaluation of Reasoning-Oriented Generalist Robot Manipulation
method_tags: real-world evaluation; VLA benchmark; reasoning-oriented tasks
relevance_to_direction: Shows evaluation is moving to standardized real-world settings. We should report robust protocol, not demo-only results.

title: vla-eval: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models
method_tags: evaluation harness; LIBERO; CALVIN; SimplerEnv; ManiSkill
relevance_to_direction: Useful for simulation sanity checks before real-arm runs and for reproducible baselines.

title: RobotArena infinity: Scalable Robot Benchmarking via Real-to-Sim Translation
method_tags: real-to-sim; human feedback; scalable benchmark
relevance_to_direction: Related to evaluating VLA generalization under cost constraints. Not central, but useful for discussion.

title: IN-RIL: Interleaved Reinforcement and Imitation Learning for Policy Fine-Tuning
method_tags: interleaved IL/RL; gradient separation; sample efficiency
relevance_to_direction: Potential training stabilizer for plug-in residual actor-critic when correction data is available.

title: RM-RL: Role-Model Reinforcement Learning for Precise Robot Manipulation
method_tags: role-model labels; online+offline; precision manipulation
relevance_to_direction: Precision manipulation with automatic labels. Useful competitor for correction label design.

title: IRL-VLA: Training a Vision-Language-Action Policy via Reward World Model
method_tags: inverse RL; reward world model; closed-loop driving
relevance_to_direction: Lower relevance because it is autonomous driving, but useful for reward-world-model framing.

title: RynnVLA-002: A Unified Vision-Language-Action and World Model
method_tags: unified VLA and world model; future prediction
relevance_to_direction: Useful related work for future-looking tokens, but likely too broad for this project.

title: LingBot-VLA: Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Real World Robot Manipulation
method_tags: 20k hours real data; cross-embodiment; open-source stack
relevance_to_direction: Important context: large-scale real data improves VLA, but ordinary labs need post-training methods under small data.

title: Precise and Dexterous Robotic Manipulation via Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
method_tags: human interventions; SERL; sample-efficient online RL
relevance_to_direction: Strong non-VLA baseline for using interventions in real-robot RL. Correction advantage should compare against this family.

title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
method_tags: transformer policy; Open X-Embodiment; generalist robot policy
relevance_to_direction: Background baseline and possible non-VLA policy comparison.

title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
method_tags: cross-embodiment dataset; RT-X; robot data scaling
relevance_to_direction: Foundational dataset reference for VLA pretraining and cross-embodiment context.
